parameters.content:
## 01 · Intake and configuration
Set private configuration values, then connect credentials.
Private chats only. No live data is included in this template.

## 02 · Owner controls
Approve / reject pending requests and list approved users.
Owner actions require the configured sender ID. Revocation / reactivation: access table.

## 03 · Document pipeline
Validate batch → copy template → fill fields → add links → export PDF → deliver → delete copy.
Only synthetic examples are provided. Configure permitted link hosts.
Cleanup is on the successful path; failed runs need operational review.

## 04 · Access lifecycle
New → pending → approved / rejected. Revoked users cannot create documents.
Keep one access row per user and one session row per chat.
